The Contractor hereby grants to the Principal (both for itself and on behalf of the applicable Subcontractors) an irrevocable, transferable (including by way of sublicense(s)), perpetual, unconditional, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence and right to access in perpetuity all such Drawings and Specifications as well as any other reports, manuals, programmes, plans, aids, results, studies, calculations, data, other documents and information (whether in physical or electronic form) prepared by or on behalf of the Contractor (including by Subcontractors) in relation to or in connection with the Contract and the Contract Works, including for the planning, design, engineering, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, completion, operation, maintenance, repair, replacement, modification, renewal, expansion and/or alteration of the Contract Works. The Contractor limits the use of all such drawings, Specifications, reports, manuals, programmes, plans, aids, results, studies, calculations, data and other documentation to the Contract works stated herein. All other use without prior permission is strictly prohibited. The Contractor will ensure that it secures all necessary rights and licences from Subcontractors in order to meet its obligations under this 2.8.2 and must execute or procure the execution of such documents and do all such things as may be necessary or reasonably desirable (from the Principal’s perspective) to give effect to the provisions of this 2.8.2.

children.name: text
children: For items to be designed and constructed by the Contractor, the Contractor shall undertake that these Contract Works items are designed, and the design developed, and design documentation prepared in accordance with professional standards of care and responsibility and in accordance with the Contract. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, but subject to the Contract, the Contractor shall in designing such works, ensure that:

children.name: text
children: the Contract Works items are designed for the Contractor by appropriate consultants in accordance with the proper professional architectural or engineering practices and principles;

children.name: text
children: insofar as the Contractor is responsible for elements of the design, all services included in the Contract Work items are professionally designed exercising all reasonable skill and care to be appropriate adequate and as described or reasonably able to be inferred from the specifications;

children.name: text
children: the documentation is co-ordinated with all other contract documentation;

children.name: text
children: the Contractor shall take out suitable Professional Indemnity insurances for the designed elements; and

children.name: text
children: the Contractor shall provide a design Producer Statement to the Engineer for items designed and constructed by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor agrees to provide such reasonable assistance to the Principal and the Principal’s consultants when requested by the Principal, to maximise integration opportunities with the Contract Works so that the costs of any other work to be carried out by the Principal are minimised to the extent reasonably possible.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor acknowledges that to facilitate the Project and achieve the Milestones in accordance with the Project Programme, the Principal may require the Contractor to work together with any other contractors of the Principal to achieve all reasonable consistency of approach and efficiencies.

children.name: text
children: {u:Insert at the End of the Clause}

The Contractor shall, without prejudice to the foregoing, communicate with and attend to each subcontractor to ensure any subcontracted work is completed in accordance with the Contract Documents and the Contractor shall make good any defect or damage upon completion of each subcontractor’s work.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall be responsible for the adequacy, stability, and safety of all Site operations including the security of the plant and equipment and the safe, secure storage of the materials in accordance with the manufacturer’s recommendations and methods of construction, provided that the Contractor shall not be responsible for the design or specification of the Contract Works except as provided under 5.1.3 and 5.1.4.

children.name: text
children: To the extent that the Principal requests it, the Contractor’s input on the Drawings and Specifications shall be to advise on the following aspects whilst maintaining or improving at all times the quality of the design (using all due care, skill and diligence):

children.name: text
children: construction and practicability of build, including environment, health and safety;

children.name: text
children: ways of reducing waste and improving sustainable outcomes for the project;

children.name: text
children: ways of affecting time savings or improving ease of construction; and

children.name: text
children: minimisation of design errors and omissions, particularly in design co-ordination.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall prepare and submit to the Engineer two-weekly written reports (1 report every 2 weeks) in relation to the Contract Works. The reports shall be in a format required by the Engineer and shall cover all aspects of time, cost, quality, environment, sustainability and safety and any other matters identified by the Engineer acting reasonably.

children.name: text
children: ensure that the execution of Contract Works does not interfere with the property or other rights of third parties unless the consent of such persons and the Principal has been obtained; and

children.name: text
children: be responsible for ensuring that it does not interfere with services or utilities which are located in the vicinity of the Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor will undertake and pay for all costs of repair and reinstatement works without reimbursement by the Principal where it has interfered with the property or other rights of third parties without the consent of those third parties and of the Principal, or interferes with services or utilities located in the vicinity of Contract Works in a manner not agreed with the service or utility provider concerned and the Principal and will indemnify and save harmless the Principal from and against all costs, claims, damages and liability arising out of or in consequence of any such matters.

children.name: text
children: Where provided in the Special Conditions, the Principal may arrange for work on the Site not included in the Contract to be carried out by Persons other than the Contractor including the Principal’s employees and concurrently with the carrying out of the Contract Works. The Contractor shall liaise and co-ordinate with, organise and manage the Separate Contractors as if they were Subcontractors for the execution of their work. The Principal shall ensure that in carrying out any such work any Separate Contractors shall in all respects comply with all reasonable requests from the Contractor.

children: {u:Insert at the End of the Clause}
For the avoidance of doubt the Contractor acknowledges that the excepted risks do not include:

children.name: text
children: a breach of the Contract by the Contractor;

children.name: text
children: negligence by the Contractor or a Subcontractor relating to the performance of the Contractor’s obligations under the Contract;

children.name: text
children: a shortage or delay in the supply of Materials required under the Contract; or

children.name: text
children: impact to the project due to COVID-19.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor undertakes that before a Subcontractor or Separate Contractor commences work on site, the Contractor will obtain similar warranties to those in 5.7.5 from that Subcontractor or Separate Contractor in relation to the sub-crontract works or separate works, as the case may be.

children.name: text
children: The Engineer shall not be bound to grant an extension unless:

children.name: text
children: The Contractor notifies the Engineer that it claims an extension and states the grounds for the extension;

children.name: text
children: The notice is given within 10 Working Days after the circumstances arise which are relied on as the grounds for extension, or as soon as practicable thereafter;

children.name: text
children: The notice either gives details of the period of extension sought or is followed within a reasonable time by a further notice giving such details; and

children.name: text
children: The event or circumstance in respect of which the extension is sought must or will cause actual delay to the critical path elements of the Contract Works, which the Contractor must show and demonstrate to the reasonable satisfaction of the Engineer.

children.name: text
children: The Principal may, at its sole and absolute discretion and notwithstanding any other provision of the Contract to the contrary, at any time and from time to time and for any reason it considers sufficient but without being under an obligation to do so, by notice to the Contractor unilaterally extend any Due Date for Completion. For the avoidance of any doubt, any such extension will not require the Contractor to slow down the progress of the Contract Works and the Contractor is entitled to complete the Contract Works and any Separable Portion prior to the date of any such extended Due Date for Completion. The Principal is not entitled to exercise its right under this 10.3.8 in order to defeat an entitlement of the Contractor under 10.3.7.

children.name: text
children: It will be a condition precedent to Practical Completion for the Site and the Contract Works to be in a clean and tidy condition and free of waste material, rubbish and litter. If in the opinion of the Engineer the Contractor has not left the Site and the Contract Works clean and tidy and free of waste material, rubbish and litter, on being requested by the Engineer, the Contractor must immediately tidy up the Site and the Contract Works to the satisfaction of the Engineer. In the event that the Contractor fails to tidy up the Site and the Contract Works to the satisfaction of the Engineer, the Engineer shall be entitled to employ a third party to tidy up the Site and Contract Works, the cost of which, alongside any penalties imposed by Kainga Ora (which may be up to $350 per day after the date on which written notice and demand has been made), the Engineer is entitled to deduct from any payments otherwise due to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: If any part of the Contract Works is replaced or repaired during the applicable Defects Notification Period, the replacement or repaired item will have the extended Defects Notification Period (commencing from the date that the item has been replaced or repaired to the satisfaction of the Principal) stated in the Special Conditions.

children.name: text
children: The Principal will be entitled to deduct or set off against any sums that would otherwise be payable by it to the Contractor, amounts in respect of any claims it has against the Contractor including, without limitation, damages awarded by a court or tribunal for breach of contract by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor agrees to the Principal that the Contractor will not do anything, or omit to do anything, or use or permit to be done, omitted or used, materials, substances or processes which:

children.name: text
children: would or could discharge, or result in a discharge of, a contaminant into the environment that is not in compliance with resource consents held by the Principal;

children.name: text
children: would cause the total emission of noise from the Site to exceed prescribed boundary noise levels;

children.name: text
children: or that would or could cause any adverse effect on the environment; or

children.name: text
children: is a breach of any duty or obligation of the Contractor under the Resource Management Act 1991 or the Building Act 2004; or

children.name: text
children: does or is likely to give rise to the issue of an abatement notice, enforcement proceedings or an excessive noise direction against the Principal, Contractor or Subcontractor under the Resource Management Act 1991 or the Building Act 2004.

children.name: text
children: Pursuant to the provisions of the Contract, it is a condition that the Contractor enter into this deed in favour of the Principal.

props.className: edit-document-table table normalize-font-size tc no-border justified first-top-align

children.name: text
children: In this deed, unless the context otherwise requires:

children.name: text
children: {em:Contract Works} has the meaning assigned to it in the Contract.

children.name: text
children: {em:Tenants} has the meaning assigned to it in the Contract.

children.name: text
children: {em:Working Day } means any day of the week (other than Saturday, Sunday and statutory holidays) on which registered banks are open for general banking business in Tauranga, New Zealand.

children.name: text
children: The expression {em:defects} extends to include all defects, faults, omissions, shrinkages, undue deterioration and other faults which are due to any materials or workmanship not being in accordance with the Contract and/or the warranty contained in clause {b:2.1} of this deed, or otherwise due to any breach of or failure to comply with the warranty under clause {b:2.1}, or otherwise due to any other defective performance of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The expression {em:repair} will include and extend to renewal and/or replacement necessary to remedy defects.

children.name: text
children: Words and expressions defined in the Contract and not otherwise defined in this deed have the same meanings when used in this deed.

children.name: text
children: In this deed, unless the context otherwise requires:

children.name: text
children: warranties and covenants given in this deed by more than one person or entity bind each of them jointly and severally;

children.name: text
children: paragraph headings are not to be used to construe this deed;

children.name: text
children: words importing the singular number include the plural number and vice versa;

children.name: text
children: words of any gender include the other gender and bodies corporate;

children.name: text
children: a party includes its successors, permitted assigns and permitted novates;

children.name: text
children: except where expressly provided to the contrary all references in this deed to “including”, “includes” or “include” are to be read as if that reference is followed by the words “without limitation”;

children.name: text
children: references to a clause, clauses, Schedule or Schedules will, unless otherwise specified, be a reference to the corresponding clause, clauses, Schedule or Schedules in this deed; and

children.name: text
children: the rule of construction known as contra proferentem will not apply to this deed.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor warrants and covenants to the Principal, up to the date that is {b:{em:Refer archictural spec}} years after the date of Practical Completion of the whole of the Contract Works under the Contract, that:

children.name: text
children: the Warranted Works will be free from defects;

children.name: text
children: all materials supplied by the Contractor for the Warranted Works will be new, unused and of the quality and in accordance with the provisions of the Contract; and

children.name: text
children: all Warranted Works will be carried out in a good and workmanlike manner and in accordance with the provisions of the Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor will at its own cost and risk, promptly, in a good and workmanlike manner, and to the satisfaction of the Principal:

children.name: text
children: repair all defects in the Warranted Works; and

children.name: text
children: make good any loss or damage to buildings, structures or services (including all fittings, fixtures and other improvements and any utilities) caused by any defect in, or repairs to, the Warranted Works, occurring during the period specified in clause {b:2.1} above.  If any building consent or other statutory approval or consent is required for any repair or make good work, the Contractor will obtain such consent or approval at its own cost.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor does not repair any defect or make good any loss or damage within 14 days (or such other period as may be reasonable but taking into account the impact of the matter on the Principal and its assets and operations) after receiving notice of that defect, loss or damage, the Principal may, without being under any obligation to do so (and without prejudice to the Principal’s rights under the Contract or otherwise), carry out the repair work and/or make good the loss or damage and recover all costs incurred in doing so from the Contractor as a debt due and payable but without releasing the Contractor from any obligation or liability.  The Principal may not proceed to carry out such repair or make good work without first giving the Contractor written notice.

children.name: text
children: The costs referred to in clause {b:2.3} may include the cost of all labour, material, travelling and other charges incurred by the Principal in repairing such defect or making good any such loss or damage.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor further indemnifies the Principal against all costs, damages, fines, penalties, losses, claims, liabilities and expense which the Principal may incur or for which the Principal may become liable arising out of or in any way connected with any failure by the Contractor to promptly repair all defects in the Warranted Works or make good any loss or damage notified to it under this deed.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor is not liable for any defect, loss or damage under this deed solely attributable to:

children.name: text
children: any negligence or wilful default of the Principal or of any occupant of the Warranted Works;

children.name: text
children: unintended use of the Warranted Works by the Principal or any occupant of the Warranted Works;

children.name: text
children: earthquake or any other forces of nature that could not have been reasonably foreseen by the Contractor (but excluding earthquakes and any other forces of nature, the effect of which was, or should reasonably have been, incorporated or taken into account or otherwise catered for in the Warranted Works);

children.name: text
children: fire, explosion, subsidence or slips not caused or contributed to by the Contractor, any Subcontractor or any of their respective employees, representatives, agents and for which the Contractor is not otherwise responsible for under the Contract; or

children.name: text
children: any failure by the Principal to maintain the Warranted Works in accordance with any proper written instructions provided to the Principal by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: For the purposes of this clause 2.6, {b:{em:occupant}} excludes the Contractor, all Subcontractors, as well as their respective employees, representatives, agents and contractors.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor will not be liable for any defect, loss or damage under this deed resulting from any neglect or delay on the part of the Principal to give notice of any defects, loss or damage within a reasonable time of the Principal becoming aware of such defects, loss or damage.

children.name: text
children: The warranty and covenant in clause {b:2.1} of this deed will be deemed to be a continuing warranty and covenant so that the Principal will be entitled from time to time and at all times during the period specified in that clause to give notice of any defect, loss or damage (or any one or more of the same) to which clause {b:2.2} of this deed applies, notwithstanding that on any other occasion prior to giving such notice the Principal may have already given notice to the Contractor in respect of such defects, loss or damage or any other defects, loss or damage to which this deed applies.

children.name: text
children: In the event that this deed is executed prior to completion of the Warranted Works, no variation to the Warranted Works subsequent to the execution of this deed will be deemed to vary the liability of the Contractor under this deed, and all references to the Warranted Works will be deemed to include the Warranted Works as originally specified together with such variations, and the issuing of any certificate of completion or any other certificate in respect of the Warranted Works or any part of the Warranted Works (or of the Contract Works or any part of the Contract Works) will not affect the liability of the Contractor under this deed.

children.name: text
children: Any dispute or difference (a {em:Dispute}) between the Principal and the Contractor arising out of this deed will be referred to arbitration in accordance with the provisions of the Arbitration Act 1996 or any statutory re-enactment or modification thereof.

children.name: text
children: The Dispute will be referred to a sole arbitrator.  If the Principal and the Contractor fail to agree upon a sole arbitrator within 15 days after receipt of the notice of Dispute, the arbitrator will be appointed by the then President of the Arbitrators' and Mediators' Institute of New Zealand (or by his or her nominee).

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding clauses 3.1 and 3.2, if any dispute or difference arises under this deed which is related to a dispute or difference under the Contract, the parties agree that, subject to any discretion to the contrary of a court, arbitrator or mediator, as the case may be, or unless otherwise required by the Principal, the dispute or difference is to be dealt with at the same time and in conjunction with the dispute or difference under the Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may not assign, charge or novate, whether in part or in whole, any of its rights, benefits or obligations under this deed without the prior written consent of the Principal (which it may or may not give at its discretion).

children.name: text
children: The Principal may assign, charge or novate all or any part of its rights and/or obligations under this deed to any assignee, chargee or novatee of the Principal under the Contract or to any other Person without the Contractor’s consent.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor must, if and when requested by the Principal, promptly do all things and execute all such documents reasonably necessary to give effect to any assignment, charge or novation by the Principal, including in the case of a novation, entering into a deed of novation with the Principal and the relevant Person nominated by the Principal in a form required by the Principal.

children.name: text
children: The obligations and liabilities on the part of the Contractor contained in this deed:

children.name: text
children: will not be deemed to be in substitution for or limit in any way the Contractor’s liability to the Principal under the Contract; and

children.name: text
children: are in addition to the obligations of the Contractor under the Contract, at law or otherwise.

children.name: text
children: Accordingly the Principal will not be precluded from exercising any rights the Principal may have against the Contractor under the Contract in respect of any defects, loss or damage to which this deed may apply, nor will the exercise of the Principal’s rights under this deed be conditional upon the exercise of those rights.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor acknowledges and agrees that, pursuant to section 4 of the Contracts (Privity) Act 1982, the rights and benefits under this deed will accrue to and be enforceable by not only the Principal and any assignee, chargee or novatee of the Principal under clause 4.2, but also by the Tenants.

children.name: text
children: In addition, the Principal has seen the form of this deed and agrees, in favour of the Contractor, that notwithstanding the Principal is not a party to this deed, the Principal will nevertheless be bound by the agreement to arbitrate contained in clauses 3.1 - 3.3.

children.name: text
children: Any notice or document required to be given under this deed must be in writing and may be given by hand, post, facsimile or email to the party’s address for service of notices set out in the execution pages of this deed or, in the case of the Principal, to its address for service of notices under the Contract.  Subject to the last paragraph of this clause 5.3.1, a notice or document is taken to have been received:

children.name: text
children: if the notice or document is delivered by hand to the receiver, at the time of delivery;

children.name: text
children: if the notice or document is posted in a postage paid registered envelope addressed to the receiver, at the time when it would be received in the ordinary course of registered post then prevailing;

children.name: text
children: if the notice or document is transmitted by facsimile and, subject to receipt of an error free transmission report by the transmitter, on the date of transmission; or

children.name: text
children: if the notice or document is sent by email, when receipt of the email is acknowledged by the receiving party by return email or otherwise in writing, except that return emails generated automatically will not constitute an acknowledgment.

children.name: text
children: If a notice or document is received after 5.00pm on a day or on a day that is not a Working Day, the notice will be deemed to be received on the next Working Day.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in clause 5.3.1, if the Principal establishes Aconex as a document management system for the Contract Works (or any part of the Contract Works), then the Principal may direct the Contractor to submit all notices and/or documents required to be given under this deed under the Aconex document management system and the Principal may submit its notices and/or documents required to be given under this deed under the Aconex document management system.   The Contractor must comply with any such direction to the exclusion of the other service methods under clause 5.3.1 unless and until the direction is revoked by the Principal.   Notices and/or documents so submitted under the Aconex document management system shall be taken as having been received at the time the notice or document is uploaded to the Aconex document management system (for the avoidance of any doubt, subject to the last paragraph of clause 5.3.1).

children.name: text
children: The Contractor must do or use its reasonable endeavours to cause to be done anything necessary or desirable to give effect to this deed and the arrangements set out in this deed, and will refrain from doing anything which might prevent full effect being given to this deed.

children.name: text
children: A waiver of any provision of this deed will not be effective unless given in writing, and then it will be effective only to the extent that it is expressly stated to be given. A failure, delay or indulgence by either the Contractor or the Principal in exercising any power or right will not operate as a waiver of that power or right.  A single exercise or partial exercise of any power or right will not preclude further exercises of that power or right or the exercise of any other power or right.

children.name: text
children: If any one or more of the provisions contained in this deed is invalid, illegal or unenforceable in any respect under any applicable law, the validity, legality and enforceability of the remaining provisions contained in this deed will not in any way be affected or impaired.

children.name: text
children: No amendment or other modification of this deed will be effective unless it is in writing, is dated and is signed by a duly authorised representative of the Contractor and the Principal.

children.name: text
children: This deed is governed by and will be construed in accordance with the laws of New Zealand, and without limitation or prejudice to clause 3 the Contractor and the Principal irrevocably submit to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of New Zealand and any courts which have jurisdiction to hear appeals from any of those courts and waive any right to object to any proceedings being brought in those courts.

children: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in clause 6.3.1, if the Principal establishes Aconex as a document management system for the Contract Works (or any part of the Contract Works), then the Principal may direct the Contractor and the Subcontractor to submit all notices and/or documents required to be given under this deed under the Aconex document management system and the Principal may submit its notices and/or documents required to be given under this deed under the Aconex document management system.   The Contractor and the Subcontractor must comply with any such direction to the exclusion of the other service methods under clause 6.3.1 unless and until the direction is revoked by the Principal.   Notices and/or documents so submitted under the Aconex document management system shall be taken as having been received at the time the notice or document is uploaded to the Aconex document management system (for the avoidance of any doubt, subject to the last paragraph of clause 6.3.1).

children.name: text
children: Each party must do or use its reasonable endeavours to cause to be done anything necessary or desirable to give effect to this deed and the arrangements set out in this deed and will refrain from doing anything which might prevent full effect being given to this deed.

children.name: text
children: A waiver of any provision of this deed will not be effective unless given in writing, and then it will be effective only to the extent that it is expressly stated to be given. A failure, delay or indulgence by either party or the Principal in exercising any power or right will not operate as a waiver of that power or right.  A single exercise or partial exercise of any power or right will not preclude further exercises of that power or right or the exercise of any other power or right.

children: If any one or more of the provisions contained in this deed is invalid, illegal or unenforceable in any respect under any applicable law, the validity, legality and enforceability of the remaining provisions contained in this deed will not in any way be affected or impaired.

children.name: text
children: No amendment or other modification of this deed will be effective unless it is in writing, is dated and is signed by a duly authorised representative of each party and the Principal.

children.name: text
children: This deed may be executed in counterparts (including facsimile or electronic copies of counterparts) and provided that each party has duly executed a counterpart, the counterparts together will constitute a valid and binding deed between the parties and the Principal.

children.name: text
children: This deed is governed by and will be construed in accordance with the laws of New Zealand, and without limitation or prejudice to clause 4 the parties and the Principal irrevocably submit to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of New Zealand and any courts which have jurisdiction to hear appeals from any of those courts and waive any right to object to any proceedings being brought in those courts.
